 Station Kotwali Police Station Kotwali
 (Madhya Pradesh)
 .
 (By Shri D.K.Paroha - Govt. Advocate )
This application coming on for admission this day,

the 
 following:
 Order

This is first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to FIR/Crime No.643/2023 registered at Police Station-Kotwali District-Seoni (MP) for the offence under Sections 363, 366-A, 376, 376(2)(n), 366 of IPC & 3/4 &
5(L)/6 of POCSO Act.
2. Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that applicant is young boy of 19 years and he was in love relationship with prosecutrix.
Prosecutrix was consenting party and he is aged about 17 years.
On these grounds, he prayed that applicant may be enlarged on bail.
3. Learned Government Advocate appearing for the State opposed the application filed by applicant.
It is submitted that allegations were made against applicant.
Consent is immaterial as prosecutrix is minor.

sentences.text: 4. Heard the counsel for the parties.
5. Applicant is young boy of 19 years.
6. Considering the statement of prosecutrix recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C, bail application filed by the applicant is allowed.
It is directed that applicant be released on bail on furnishing personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court.
C.C. as per rules.
